# Sirach Chapter 26 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 26 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**26:1** Blessed is the-husband of a-good-wife; the-number of-his-days will-be-doubled.

**26:2** A-capable-wife brings-joy to-her-husband, and he-will-complete his-years in-peace.

**26:3** A-good-wife is a-good-portion; she-will-be-given in-the-portion of-those-who-fear the-LORD.

**26:4** Whether-rich or-poor, his-heart is-glad and his-face is-cheerful at-all-times.

**26:5** From-three-things my-heart was-in-dread, and on-account-of a-fourth I-prostrated-my-face: the-slander of a-city, and the-gathering of a-mob, and a-false-accusation — all-these are-worse-than-death;

**26:6** but a-grief-of-heart and a-sorrow [is] a-wife who-is-jealous of another-wife, and a-tongue-lashing that-makes-known [everything] to-all.

**26:7** An-evil-wife is a-yoke that-chafes; taking-hold-of her is-like-grasping a-scorpion.

**26:8** A-drunken-wife arouses great-wrath, and she-will-not-cover her-own-shame.

**26:9** The-fornication of a-woman is in-the-lifting of-her-eyes, and in-her-eyelids she-will-be-recognized.

**26:10** Toward a-defiant daughter keep a-strict watch, lest she-make-use of an-opportunity of-laxity for herself.

**26:11** Beware-of her-eye that-wanders, and do-not-be-surprised if against-you she-sins.

**26:12** Like a-thirsty-traveler she-will-open her-mouth, and she-will-drink from every water near her; against-every stake she-will-sit-down, and against-every-arrow she-will-open her-quiver.

**26:13** The-grace of a-wife will-delight her-husband, and her-discernment will-fatten his-bones.

**26:14** A-silent-wife is a-gift of-the-LORD, and there-is-no-recompense for a-disciplined-soul.

**26:15** A-modest-wife has-grace upon-grace, and there-is-no-weighing-of a-continent-soul.

**26:16** Like the-sun when it-rises-up in-the-highest heavens — so is the-beauty of a-good-wife in-the-ordering of-her-house.

**26:17** Like the-lamp shining upon the-holy-lampstand — so is the-beauty of a-face upon a-well-set-up body.

**26:18** Like golden-pillars upon silver-bases — so are beautiful feet upon firm-heels.

**26:19** My-child, preserve the-bloom of-your-youth in-good-health, and do-not-give your-strength to-strangers.

**26:20** Having-sought out a-fertile-field in-all-the-land, sow it with-your-own-seed, trusting-in the-nobility of-your-own-offspring.

**26:21** And your-offspring — those-who-survive you — will-be-great, having-confidence in their-well-born-nature.

**26:22** A-hired-woman is-regarded like spittle, but a-married-woman is a-tower-of-death to-those-who-lay-hold-of-her.

**26:23** A-lawless-woman will-be-given as a-portion to a-lawless-man, but a-godly-woman is-given to a-man who-fears-God.

**26:24** A-shameless-woman will-be-put-to-shame in-all-humiliations, but an-honorable-woman will-even-be-regarded with-honor.

**26:25** A-lawless-woman fears-not shame, but an-honorable-woman will-be-ashamed before-her-husband.

**26:26** A-woman who-honors her-husband will-seem-wise to-all; but she-who-dishonors-him in-arrogance will-be-known-to-all as ungodly. A-loud-voiced-wife — like a trumpet it-is-heard in-every-noise; and a-woman-like-that — every-man-at-war will-lend-her-his-ear.

**26:27** Two-things bring-grief to-my-heart, and on-account-of a-third wrath comes-upon-me: a-man-of-war struggling-because-of-poverty, and men-of-discernment treated-as-rubbish; a-man-who-leaves-behind-righteousness for-sin — the-LORD will-make-him-ready for-the-sword.

**26:28** [A-merchant is-hardly-free-from-negligence, and a-trader will-not-be-innocent-of-sin.]

**26:29** [Many have-sinned for the-sake-of a-gain, and he-who-seeks to-multiply [wealth] will-turn-away his-eye.]
